title: pi-telegram-notify configuration
description: Configuration for the pi-telegram-notify Pi extension.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema, used by editors for validation and completion.

botToken.description: Telegram Bot API token. Keep this file private.

chatId.description: Telegram recipient chat ID, group ID, or @channelusername. Use a string to avoid numeric precision loss.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the Telegram Bot API. Notification delivery never blocks Pi's agent loop.
